notes: Ultra Retro now actively retires any legacy visual node carried over by an older cached desktop script, leaving the neofetch readout as the only diagnostic layer.
changes: The shared theme no longer defines the old crosshatch pseudo-element.
NovaShell now removes stale gyro, gesture, and hero nodes whenever Ultra Retro initializes or becomes the selected theme.
Pocket Archive retains the tested PS1 readiness guard from the previous release.
